text.en: Piercing arrowhead that damages the target on entry and exit. One shot can overpenetrate multiple targets.

This arrow deals 3 instances of damage. 

The arrow itself deals <pve 125 /> <pvp [129] /> damage and can deal Precision Damage. Broadhead deals <pve two /> <pvp [one] /> addition hits, each dealing <pve 235 /> <pvp [28.75] /> damage, and cannot deal Precision Damage.

This arrow deals 3 instances of damage.

The arrow itself deals <pve 276 /> <pvp [129] /> damage, which is further increased by dealing Precision Damage. Broadhead deals <pve two /> <pvp [one] /> addition hits, each dealing <pve 444 /> <pvp [28.75] /> damage, and is unaffected by Precision Damage.

A single arrow can deal up to <pve 1164 /> <pvp [159] /> damage.
